QUOTE: The library itself creates no threads. The only spawn sites the index finds are in `programs/`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states that the library creates no threads, but it frames the library's mutex code as compiled out in the default build. It never says that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. It describes `threading.c` and per-file locks, but not as an abstraction offered to callers who create the threads.
